subject: DONE s378: `package X;` inside ANY block now re-homes unqualified globals (source-level requalification)
description:
DONE s378.  `_requalify_block_globals_after_pkg_switch` in Pl/Parser2.pm —
a sibling pre-pass beside the `our` one, run right after it, requalifying a
package-switched block region's variables at the SOURCE level through the
shared `_rewrite_var_uses` family rewriter.

WIDER THAN THE TITLE: probed across nine block kinds — eval, do, named sub,
BEGIN, if, while, labelled, anon sub, sort — ALL were wrong; only the plain
bare block was right, and only because D1-lite splits that one shape into
separate top-level CL forms.

Resolver = the ruled four-way (lexical / in-scope `our` → declaring package /
already qualified / else → X), off the existing scope walk; unreadable
declarator DIES.  The s377 §9.1 `our`-alias guard probe is FIXED by the same
pass, not filed as a companion.

Verification: gate 133/4787 PASS; full sweep GATE clean (0 new/0 fixed,
TOTAL 18498 → 18499); corpus-diff 8 of 111, all one mechanism; CPAN board
byte-identical to s376; die-scan zero over lib/ (21) and the board (324);
gen v2-126 → v2-127 with both transpiled artifacts regenerated.

Three latent bugs fixed on the way: last-declaration-wins in the scope walk;
"$Foo::bar" is one qualified name to `_interp_canon` and `_interp_fixer`
(unbraced arms gained `(?!::)`); `local` excluded from the declarator test
via a new keyword-regex argument on `_symbol_is_declarator`.

RESIDUE → task #287 (the new ask the call-shape probe surfaced): `$a`/`$b`
are immune, which is exactly what keeps Sort-Versions versions.t at 65/31.
Measured both ways — see #287.
